title: 第17章 族会风波族长口谕第18章 天地奇火的消息柳城主的震惊
content_zh:
叶家大殿内，一片死寂，压抑的气氛让许多人都喘不过气来。
这些年叶倾城执掌家族生意，位高权重，不止一次遭受弹劾，但每一次叶倾城都选择息事宁人，不是她没有脾气，只是因为势单力薄。
尽管她有着常人难以企及的聪明才智，商业头脑，但终归是一个无法修炼的凡人。
在这个武道兴盛，实力为尊的世界，她终究是没有什么前途可言的。
所以叶德元等人才从不将这位少族长放在眼里，无论她为家族做过多么庞大的贡献，在他们眼中也只是家族的工具罢了。
即便是那些同情叶倾城的人，也不敢为了一个没有前途的人去得罪掌握家族武力的叶德元等人，而选择中立，默不作声。
一直以来，叶倾城都是很孤独的！
她一个人背负了太多太多，但这一次她不愿再沉默下去。
不仅是为了苏尘，也是为了她自己，为了抗争她这些年所受的不公平待遇！
此刻，看着神情严肃，目光决然的叶倾城，叶德元等人的脸色都阴沉如水，但一时间也不知该如何反驳。
双方就这么对峙着，周围的空气都降至了冰点。
“叶倾城，上次你命人打伤我儿叶陵，也没见你跪下道歉，今天老子不跪又如何？”
最终，还是脾气火爆的叶德林最先按耐不住了，脸色蛮横的怒吼道。
爆发的真气在大殿内肆虐，给凡人之躯的叶倾城带来了极大的压力，看起来一言不合就想动手。
“给你跪下道歉？你也配！”
苏尘直接走到叶倾城的身前，直视着蛮横的叶德林，喝道：“叶陵是我打的！
他勾结张坤，意图谋害少族长，没宰了他已经算是格外开恩了！”
人们看向苏尘的眼神顿时变得惊异起来。
毕竟苏尘血脉天赋被废，修为完全丧失，这是人尽所知的，怎么可能是叶陵和张坤的对手？
他们之前还一直认为，是叶倾城命手下侍女干的。

就连叶倾城也震惊的看了苏尘一眼。
她主动承担下这个责任，就是为了防止叶德林对苏尘不利，毕竟她还有少族长的身份保护，叶德林不敢明目张胆的胡来。
可苏尘那就不一样了，整个叶家根本没人把他这个废物赘婿放在眼里。
就算苏尘不想承她的情，也不该在这个时候说出来激怒对方，这太莽撞了。
果不其然，叶德林瞬间发飙了。
“小畜生，你好大的胆子！
今天，我就用你的血，来给我儿叶陵赔罪！”
叶德林睁着血红的双眼，如同杀意滔天的野兽，想要把苏尘撕碎。
“那你得有那个本事！”
苏尘冷笑了一声，脸上毫无惧意，体内更是有雄浑的真气在升腾。
“来人，给我抓住他！
今天，老夫要让你求生不得，求死不能！”
叶德林怒吼了一声道。
嗖！
嗖！
瞬间，叶德林的身后，一尊气息强大的侍卫，眸光冷酷无比，周身真气鼓荡，探手朝着苏尘抓去。
气武境三层的武者！
感觉到那侍卫的强大，叶倾城也是脸色大变，急忙上前呵斥道：“住手！”
content_en:
There was a dead silence in the Ye family hall, and the depressing atmosphere made many people breathless.
Over the years, Ye Qingcheng has been in charge of the family business, holding a high and powerful position, and has been impeached more than once. But every time, Ye Qingcheng chose to settle the matter, not because she has no temper, but because she is weak.
Although she has intelligence and business acumen that are beyond the reach of ordinary people, she is ultimately a mortal who cannot cultivate.
In this world where martial arts flourished and strength was respected, she had no future after all.
Therefore, Ye Deyuan and other talents never take this young patriarch seriously. No matter how much she has contributed to the family, in their eyes, she is just a tool of the family.
Even those who sympathized with Ye Qingcheng did not dare to offend Ye Deyuan and others who controlled the family's force for a person with no future, and chose to remain neutral and remain silent.
Ye Qingcheng has always been very lonely!
She had shouldered too much alone, but this time she didn't want to be silent anymore.
Not only for Su Chen, but also for herself, to fight against the unfair treatment she has received over the years!
At this moment, looking at Ye Qingcheng with a serious expression and resolute eyes, Ye Deyuan and others' faces were as gloomy as water, but for a moment they didn't know how to refute.
The two sides were facing each other like this, and the surrounding air dropped to freezing point.
"Ye Qingcheng, last time you ordered someone to hurt my son Ye Ling, but you didn't kneel down to apologize. So what if I don't kneel down today?"
In the end, Ye Delin, who was still hot-tempered, couldn't hold it anymore and roared with a arrogant expression.
The burst of true energy raged in the hall, putting great pressure on the mortal Ye Qingcheng, who seemed to want to take action at the slightest disagreement.
"Kneel down and apologize to you? You deserve it!"
Su Chen walked directly in front of Ye Qingcheng, looked directly at the arrogant Ye Delin, and shouted: "I beat Ye Ling!
He colluded with Zhang Kun with the intention of murdering the young patriarch, so it was an extra mercy not to kill him! "
People's eyes suddenly became surprised when they looked at Su Chen.
After all, everyone knew that Su Chen's bloodline talent was abolished and his cultivation was completely lost. How could he be Ye Ling and Zhang Kun's opponent?
They had always believed that Ye Qingcheng ordered his maid to do it.
Even Ye Qingcheng looked at Su Chen in shock.
She took the initiative to take on this responsibility just to prevent Ye Delin from doing harm to Su Chen. After all, she still had the protection of the young patriarch, and Ye Delin did not dare to do anything blatantly.
But Su Chen was different. No one in the entire Ye family took his useless son-in-law seriously.
Even if Su Chen didn't want to acknowledge her affection, he shouldn't say it at this time to anger the other person. It was too reckless.
Sure enough, Yedlin went crazy instantly.
"You little beast, you are so brave!
Today, I will use your blood to apologize to my son Ye Ling! "
Ye Delin opened his blood-red eyes, like a beast with murderous intent, wanting to tear Su Chen into pieces.
"Then you must have that ability!"
Su Chen sneered, with no fear on his face, and powerful Qi rising in his body.
"Come here, catch him!
Today, I will make you unable to survive or die! "
Yedlin roared angrily.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
In an instant, behind Ye Delin, a guard with a powerful aura appeared, his eyes were extremely cold, his true energy was surging around his body, and he reached out to grab Su Chen.
A warrior at the third level of Qi Martial Realm!
Feeling the strength of the guard, Ye Qingcheng's expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly stepped forward and yelled: "Stop!"
